narrator.rule: The narrator only says what the profile says. Every sentence can be traced to a section, a claim or the music/movement DNA.
narrator.identity: one narrator for the whole atlas: the same face and animation everywhere; a native-speaker voice of the same character per language (studio-grade); the viewer chooses the language

scenes.title: Where and when
narration: The dance was created in 1952 at Balboa High School in San Francisco.
It gained national attention through Ray Anthony's big band recordings in 1952 and 1953.
on_screen: Map: United States · North America
Image — MISSING

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: It is a social novelty dance used at weddings, parties, and social events.
It has been used in popular culture to signify lighthearted or nostalgic social interaction.
Today it is a living tradition.
on_screen: Footage: The Wiggles: Furry Tales [2013] (https://archive.org/details/furry-tales-2013)

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: Participants form a line or circle, holding the hips of the person in front.
The sequence involves two taps with the right foot, two taps with the left, one hop forward, one hop backward, and three hops forward.
Watch for The Hop Sequence.
on_screen: Hero video full screen, 30–45 s (EmC1KyxhEJU)
Captions name each signature move as it appears
